content:
Excited to share that I’ve joined the **CDS Hooks Project Management Committee**.

I’ve been working with the CDS Hooks standard since **2017**, so it’s especially meaningful to have the opportunity to help guide its next phase. I’m looking forward to helping move the standard forward and supporting broader adoption across the ecosystem.

If your organization is already using CDS Hooks, please consider adding your implementation here:
https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability

And if you’re not using CDS Hooks yet but are exploring how to implement it, I’m available as a **freelance consultant** and would be happy to help.

#CDSHooks #HealthIT #Interoperability #ClinicalDecisionSupport #FHIR #DigitalHealth
